question: Qualify the oracle-free direct INT8 prefill route (HIPENGINE_GGUF_INT8_PREFILL_DIRECT, now with the GQA-grouped flash kernel) for default-on promotion: speed was the recorded blocker, and the production-profile numerics campaign for the INT8-read prefill arithmetic was the recorded precondition.
change_under_test: Direct route prefill attention reads the retained INT8 K/V store with per-token/head scales instead of the write-through BF16 oracle pair; kernel selection HIPENGINE_GGUF_INT8_PREFILL_KERNEL=flash (new GQA-grouped flash kernel, commit 2082f1353) or sequential (41f19ea95).
protocol: scripts/qwen35_native_mixed_kv_suite.py, ten-prompt mtpbench category corpus plus mixed_v1 control, teacher-forced full-vocabulary rows vs the BF16-KV reference policy, pure-INT8 env (HIPENGINE_GGUF_INT8_KV_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_LONG=1, HIPENGINE_GGUF_INT8_KV_BF16_FULL_LAYERS=none). The short-context BF16 mirror policy means the direct route is only planned above 8,192 max positions, so the 4,096-token rows run with --max-sequence-length 16384 (no mirror) to exercise the route; the 512-token rows are the mirror route (both arms bit-identical to BF16, recorded as the engagement control).

engagement_control_512.direct_off: 11/11 rows KL 0.0, bit-identical logits to the direct-on arm: the mirror route is engaged below the 8,192-position threshold and the direct env is inert there (the 4,096 no-mirror arms are the real comparison).

verdict: REJECTED for default-on promotion. The speed blocker is fixed (8,192-token harness A/B: oracle 767.4 vs direct+flash 552.5 tok/s, 72%; sequential 164), and the flash kernel is route-level numerically equivalent to the sequential kernel (identical failure profile, mean row-KL 0.215 vs 0.216), so the restructure is behavior-preserving. But the INT8-read prefill arithmetic itself - the route design, not the kernel - fails the broad project smoke ceiling (mean row-KL 0.215 vs 0.05, max 6.4, top-1 as low as 0.71) where the pure-INT8 oracle route measures 0.003. The BF16 oracle pair is what preserves prefill quality on the pure-INT8 route; removing it trades ~72x mean KL for the oracle pair's memory. The gate stays default OFF; the route remains an opt-in capacity lever with this quality cost measured and recorded.
